title: Dark Clouds
paragraphs: After that, the Queen discussed the internal affairs of Melromarc, and in front of the people of Faubrey, Father repeated the strategy. It seems that the people of Faubrey have no objections. They probably believe that as long as they have the protection of the Heroes, everything will work out. Some of those present had witnessed the battle against Takt, after all.
“Then let us depart. Are the Heroes ready?”
“Yeah, we’re good to go, Eclair-san.”
“Hmm… my arms are itching for battle.”
Éclair seems quite motivated as well. Well, this is a fight to protect her homeland, so it’s natural for her to feel fired up. I feel the same when it comes to protecting Filo-tan and Father.
“By the way, Eclair-san, do you want to undergo a limit-breaking class upgrade? You can do it now, and there’s no downside to getting it done.”
“No… Let’s resolve the matter with Melromarc first. Besides, I haven’t been officially assigned to assist the Heroes. I need the Queen’s permission to accompany you.”
“I have nothing in particular to say against it. If Lady Seaetto is needed for world peace, then as Melromarc’s representative, I shall grant my approval.”
With that, the Queen gave her consent.
“The next step is fine-tuning the details. We’re going to use the Portal to transport Faubrey and the allied soldiers, right?”
“That should come later. First, we need to secure the area. Capturing the Three Hero Church followers infesting the castle takes priority.”
“Yeah, either way, this is a troublesome situation. We need to move quickly to prevent any further damage from the Three Hero Church.”
And so, we decided to head to Melromarc via Portal. The Queen and her fiancé were added to our group. Reclaiming the castle is the top priority.
“Huh? The Portal to the place where we were summoned isn’t working.”

Normally, despite being inside a building, we can teleport to the location where we were originally summoned. But for some reason, it’s now showing as unavailable. We should be able to catch a brief glimpse of the teleportation destination’s condition, but even that is flickering and unreadable.
“This is strange.”
“Then what about the castle gardens or a nearby village? Can we teleport there?”
“That shouldn’t be a problem.”

We have a lot of recorded Portal locations within Melromarc. Initially, only three spots could be registered, but by leveling up the skill and using enhancement methods, we’ve expanded both the number of locations and the number of people we can teleport at once. In the worst-case scenario, we can use an Energy Boost to transport even more people. It would be ideal if we could teleport vehicles as well. That is the only drawback. I check several locations to see where we can teleport. It seems that we can’t teleport to the castle town of Melromarc.

What could be happening there? Well, just in case something like this happened, I had also registered a Portal in the Melromarc plains. I had marked it when I was considering whether I could find Father within the loop.
“Portal Spear!”
After chanting, I teleported together with everyone to Melromarc.
“Oh? This is the plains, huh?”
Father and the others, accustomed to teleportation, simply checked the surroundings without showing much surprise.
“This is the power of the Heroes… incredible…”
The fiancé let out an admiring voice. He always reacts with amazement whenever we teleport.
“For now, let’s use Motoyasu-kun’s concealment skill and magic to infiltrate Melromarc—”

As he said that, Father turned toward the castle and fell silent. The same went for Ren and Itsuki. I also had a bad feeling about this. After all, dark clouds were ominously gathering over the entire castle town, including Melromarc Castle. Just that alone made the castle gates appear strange, which was truly eerie.
“Hey, is it just my imagination? The castle town of Melromarc looks… ominous, or rather…”
“It looks devastated. Did something happen?”
“It feels like something straight out of an old RPG. Everything seems dim.”
Father and the others kept tilting their heads in confusion. Even when it rained before, the atmosphere had never felt this ominous.
“Is something wrong?”
“Something wrong?”
Since this is the first time for the assistant and the mole, they probably don’t feel any discomfort.
“I’m getting a really bad feeling—”
“Indeed.”
“It’s so dark—”
“Ominous… this land is tainted.”
It seems Yuki-chan and Rival can sense it.
But… a tainted land, huh? Just what is happening here?
“Was Melromarc always like this…? It feels completely different from how I remember it…”
“No! No matter how you look at it, something is definitely wrong!”
Éclair immediately responded. Ah, so even from Éclair’s perspective, this looks completely different.
“Yes, I won’t say our country is perfectly normal, but… it shouldn’t be radiating such an evil presence…”
“Our country…”
The queen and the fiancé looked at the castle town with expressions that showed they were struggling to accept reality. For them, this is their homeland. Seeing it in this state must feel terrible.
“How should I put it… it gives off the same atmosphere as the final stage of some video game.”
“That’s the best wording you could come up with? Well… I can’t deny that the moment we step inside, it feels like we’ll be immediately ambushed by monsters.”
“This is way too strange. What exactly is going on here?”
“Isn’t it that? Maybe they used the brainwashing weapons to take over the people who didn’t comply with them.”
That isn’t entirely out of the question. The problem is that Itsuki, the key figure, is missing. I try using the same ability as Father to sense the flow of energy.
…Even without using it, I can tell that there is something completely abnormal going on right now!
“F-For now, should we try sneaking in?”
“Yes, though I feel bad for the citizens, let’s go in from the front.”
“We’re not exactly going for a no-kill approach, but if we get caught, let’s use status ailments to minimize casualties.”
“Then should I go in with Paralysis Lance?”
We are fully prepared. At least, that’s what I thought, but Father shook his head.

“If there are too many enemies, Motoyasu-kun, you’d probably end up wiping them out with an area-of-effect skill, right? In this case, wouldn’t it be better to let Itsuki handle it, considering his rapid-fire capability?”
“You’re right. Given the shape of my current weapon, I’ll use Paralysis Bullet to quickly paralyze any enemies that approach.”
“We need to make sure Itsuki doesn’t run out of SP.”
“Wouldn’t it be easier to just burn everything down with magic from the outside?”
“Good idea—do you really think I’d say that? Denied.”
“Are you trying to make things even more complicated, Motoyasu?!”
Father and the others are so serious about this.
Even I think burning down the castle town would be a problem, but the castle itself should be fine, right? They can always rebuild it later.
“Gaelion will release a breath of status ailments from upwind!”
“Is that really the best idea…? It could end up affecting our allies too.”
“Sakura and the others will do their best too—!”
“This… sounds like it’s going to be really difficult.”
“Yes, but if it means making the country better, I want to do my best.”
Rival and the other Filolials each voiced their determination. All that’s left are the queen and the fiancé.
“We appreciate your cooperation, Heroes.”
“Thank you.”
“Then Mel-chan, you can ride on Sakura’s back—”
“Okay, Sakura-chan.”
Sakura transformed into her Filolial form and carried the fiancé on her back.
“Let’s go.”
Nodding at Éclair’s words, we cast concealment magic and infiltrated the castle town.
“Ugh…”
“Aah…”
A cart rumbled past us. Additionally, here and there in the castle town, people slumped against walls, groaning in a daze.
What is this? Are they… on drugs or something?
